page.overview:
What is Isle of Armor?

The Isle of Armor is a large island in the Galar region featured in The Isle of Armor expansion. It is located off the east coast of the mainland, close to Spikemuth and Hulbury, and is home to Mustard's dojo, the Master Dojo. It is where the player is able to receive Kubfu. It is based on the , but also shares some similarities to .

During The Crown Tundra's story, Galarian Moltres will be roaming across the Isle of Armor.

To get to it, one needs to use the Armor Pass received after the game is updated.
